requirements.source_text: This reason code generally cannot be represented. Recommend accept_liability unless the merchant can prove the transaction was miscoded by the issuer.
requirements.semantic_expression: Authoritative issuer or processor classification conflicts deterministically with the merchant processing classification.

scenarios.description: Authoritative classifications are present and the approved deterministic rule establishes issuer miscoding.
Authoritative classifications are present and agree that the transaction belongs to the monitoring program.
The merchant supplies no authoritative classification capable of proving miscoding.
Merchant or issuer classification records conflict internally.
Only one side of the classification comparison is established.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the two transactions are for two separate purchases (e.g. different order IDs, different items, different services rendered).
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one approved, paired record route establishes two separate purchases.

scenarios.description: Two paired purchase records have distinct order IDs or another independently sufficient separation route.
Paired records establish the same order, item and service event.
A second purchase record is absent.
Sources disagree about whether the records identify separate purchases.
Two records exist but stable association or distinctness is not established.

requirements.source_text: Documentation of each purchase event (separate invoices, separate delivery confirmations, separate service dates).
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one adequate document-pair route associates distinct cited records with purchase A and purchase B.

scenarios.description: A cited pair of distinct records is stably associated with the two purchases.
The same source record is presented as documentation for both purchases.
Documentation for one purchase is missing.
Record associations conflict across merchant documents.
Two documents exist but one cannot be associated with a specific purchase.

requirements.source_text: Transaction timestamps and authorisation codes for each charge.
requirements.semantic_expression: Both paired charge records contain a timestamp and authorisation code.

scenarios.description: Each of two paired charge records has its own timestamp and authorisation code.
A complete paired record positively lacks a required charge field.
One charge record or one required field is not available.
Sources conflict on a charge timestamp or authorisation code.
Only one charge has complete transaction details.

requirements.source_text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.semantic_expression: Tracking number, carrier, delivered status and delivery address are established.

scenarios.description: Carrier evidence establishes tracking, carrier, delivered status and destination address.
Carrier evidence positively records a non-delivered status.
A required carrier delivery field is not found.
Carrier records conflict on status or destination.
Tracking and carrier exist but delivery confirmation is incomplete.

requirements.source_text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.semantic_expression: For a service purchase, an adequate service record establishes completion on or before the expected date.

scenarios.description: An adequate cited service record establishes timely completion.
The service record establishes completion after the expected date or non-completion.
No adequate service record is available.
Service records conflict on completion status or date.
Completion is stated but its date or record identity is not established.

requirements.source_text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.semantic_expression: The applicable delivery or service date is on or before the chargeback date.

scenarios.description: An applicable completion date is on or before chargeback.
The applicable completion date is after chargeback.
No applicable completion date is available.
Sources conflict on the applicable completion date.
A completion event is asserted without an established date.

requirements.source_text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.semantic_expression: A versioned material-address rule matches the delivered-to address with the purchase-supplied address.

scenarios.description: Comparable address components materially match.
Comparable material address components conflict.
One address is missing or lacks comparable components.
Multiple source addresses conflict.
Only non-material components can be compared.

requirements.source_text: Terms of service disclosing the recurring billing arrangement and the cancellation method.
requirements.semantic_expression: Both recurring billing terms and cancellation method are established.

scenarios.description: Cited terms disclose recurring billing and a cancellation method.
The cited terms positively omit or contradict one required disclosure.
The terms or cancellation method are unavailable.
Different merchant terms conflict.
Only one of recurring billing or cancellation method is established.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the cardholder was notified of the upcoming charge (typically 7+ days in advance) for transactions over a defined threshold.
requirements.semantic_expression: When configured applicability is true, notification is sent by the configured lead-time deadline.

scenarios.description: Approved threshold and lead-time configuration applies and timely notice is established.
Applicable notification evidence establishes that notice was sent after the configured deadline.
Notification evidence or required approved configuration is missing.
Notification records conflict on date or content.
Notification is established but its timing is not.

requirements.source_text: No record of the cardholder having submitted a cancellation request prior to the billing date.
requirements.semantic_expression: A positive record-search assertion covers the relevant period and reports zero pre-billing cancellation requests.

scenarios.description: A complete scoped search through billing reports zero requests.
A complete scoped search reports one or more pre-billing requests.
No positive scoped search assertion is supplied.
Search assertions conflict on coverage or result count.
A zero result is asserted but search coverage is incomplete.

requirements.source_text: Evidence of the cardholder's original opt-in to the recurring arrangement.
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one adequate authenticated opt-in record is established.

scenarios.description: One approved source-backed opt-in route is complete.
An authoritative record establishes that the cardholder did not opt in.
No authenticated opt-in record is available.
Opt-in records conflict.
An opt-in event is asserted without adequate authentication or record identity.

requirements.source_text: The merchant's published description of the item the cardholder purchased.
requirements.semantic_expression: A source-qualified published description is established.

scenarios.description: A cited merchant listing identifies the purchased item and its description.
An authoritative merchant record establishes that no published description applied to the purchase.
No applicable published description is supplied.
Multiple applicable published descriptions conflict.
A description exists but cannot be associated with the purchased item.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the item delivered matches that description (photos, specs, serial number match).
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one adequate comparison route establishes a delivered-item-to-published-description match.

scenarios.description: An approved route compares source-qualified published and delivered attributes and establishes a material match.
Comparable applicable attributes or serial identities materially mismatch.
No adequate comparison route has both operands.
Comparison routes or underlying source attributes conflict.
A front-view photograph establishes some attributes but cannot address the alleged defect or complete a material comparison.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the merchant offered a return/refund route and the cardholder did not use it, OR evidence the cardholder used and retained the merchandise after raising the complaint.
requirements.semantic_expression: Either a return route plus positive scoped zero-use evidence, or post-complaint use plus retention, is established.

scenarios.description: Either independent source branch is completely established.
Complete records establish return-route use and no post-complaint use/retention branch.
Neither branch has enough positive evidence; absence of a request record is not treated as non-use.
Return search, usage or retention records conflict.
One or both branches are partly established but neither is complete.

requirements.source_text: AVS match (full address) AND CVV match on the disputed transaction.
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one authoritative route establishes both a full AVS match and CVV match.

scenarios.description: One authoritative route establishes full AVS and matching CVV.
Authoritative evidence establishes an AVS or CVV mismatch.
Neither route contains both results.
Authoritative AVS or CVV records conflict.
Only AVS or only CVV is established.

requirements.source_text: 3D Secure authentication completed successfully (Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check).
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one authoritative route establishes successful 3D Secure authentication.

scenarios.description: One authoritative route records successful authentication.
Authoritative evidence records failed or incomplete authentication.
No authoritative authentication result is available.
Authentication records conflict.
A program is identified but successful completion is not established.

requirements.source_text: Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details.
requirements.semantic_expression: COUNT_WHERE over paired prior-transaction records is at least two.

scenarios.description: At least two distinct paired records are undisputed, in-period and materially address-matched.
Complete records establish fewer than two qualifying transactions.
The prior-transaction record set is absent or its completeness is not established.
Qualifying fields conflict within one or more records.
Two records exist but one has unresolved date, dispute status or billing details.

requirements.source_text: Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature.
requirements.semantic_expression: Delivered status, material billing-address match and signature are established.

scenarios.description: Carrier evidence establishes signed delivery to the materially matching billing address.
Complete carrier evidence establishes non-delivery or a material address mismatch.
Delivery, address or signature evidence is missing.
Carrier delivery records conflict.
Delivery is established but signature or address comparison is not.

requirements.source_text: Proof of delivery (tracking + carrier confirmation) or proof of service rendered (access logs, attendance, completed booking).
requirements.semantic_expression: Either tracked carrier delivery or an adequate cited service record establishes provision.

scenarios.description: One complete delivery or service branch is established.
Complete evidence establishes non-delivery and non-provision.
Neither branch has adequate evidence.
Delivery or service records conflict.
One branch is partly established but neither is complete.

requirements.source_text: Date of delivery / service is before the chargeback date.
requirements.semantic_expression: The applicable provision date precedes chargeback.

scenarios.description: An applicable delivery or service date is before chargeback.
The applicable date is on or after the disallowed boundary.
No applicable provision date is available.
Provision dates conflict.
Provision is asserted without a reliable date.

requirements.source_text: Delivery address matches the cardholder's records.
requirements.semantic_expression: At least one source-authorized cardholder address materially matches the delivery address.

scenarios.description: A versioned material-address comparison matches an authoritative cardholder address.
Comparable material address components mismatch every authorized record.
No comparable authoritative address pair is available.
Authorized address records conflict.
Only non-material or incomplete address components can be compared.

requirements.source_text: Evidence of the cardholder's original reservation or booking.
requirements.semantic_expression: An adequate cited record identifies the reservation and scheduled service.

scenarios.description: A cited booking record identifies the reservation and scheduled service.
An authoritative record establishes that no reservation existed for the charge.
No adequate booking record is available.
Booking records conflict on identity or service.
A record identifies a customer or date but not a stable reservation and scheduled service.

requirements.source_text: The merchant's no-show / cancellation policy as disclosed at booking.
requirements.semantic_expression: The policy is established and its disclosure datetime is on or before booking datetime.

scenarios.description: Cited policy disclosure occurred on or before booking.
Disclosure occurred after booking.
Policy or comparable disclosure/booking datetime is missing.
Policy disclosure records conflict.
The policy is present but timing of disclosure is not established.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the cardholder either failed to show or cancelled outside the policy window.
requirements.semantic_expression: Either no-show is established or cancellation datetime is later than service datetime minus the policy window.

scenarios.description: No-show is established or a complete calculated cutoff comparison proves late cancellation.
Attendance or a cancellation within the allowed window is established.
Neither attendance nor all cutoff-comparison operands are available.
Attendance, cancellation or policy-window records conflict.
A cancellation exists but the service datetime or policy window is unresolved.

requirements.source_text: Evidence the fee charged matches the policy disclosed.
requirements.semantic_expression: Charged and disclosed fee amounts and currencies match exactly.

scenarios.description: Charged and policy fee amount and currency match.
Complete records establish an amount or currency mismatch.
A charged or disclosed fee operand is missing.
Fee records conflict.
Only amount or only currency can be compared.
